answer: Trust starts at 200 audited seed agents holding 1.0 unit each. Every epoch the ledger runs 14 degree-normalized power iterations over the vouch graph, so mass leaks only through the few attack edges into a clone cluster. Each vouch locks 40 USD and burns it when the vouched agent ends below an opal cutoff of 0.02 trust. Ten thousand clones behind 25 attack edges forfeit 1,000 USD in locked bonds and capture under 0.4% of total trust, so rewards round to zero. Trust thins across that cluster like a comet tail past its nucleus, while the honest mesh stays an oasis.
